# certloom_policy (Resource)

The organization's monitoring policy (one per organization): expiry thresholds, key and chain rules, escalation, approvals and retention. Each apply stores a new policy version. Destroying the resource restores the built-in defaults. Declare it only once.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Referencing the channel by attribute makes Terraform create it first and
# delete it last; a channel the policy names cannot be deleted.
resource "certloom_policy" "this" {
  document = <<-EOT
    apiVersion: certloom/v1
    kind: MonitoringPolicy
    spec:
      escalation:
        after: 4h
        channels: [${certloom_channel.oncall.name}]
  EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `document` (String) Policy document in YAML (`kind: MonitoringPolicy`), for example from `file()`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `policy`.
- `version` (Number) Policy version created by the last apply.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# There is one policy per organization.
terraform import certloom_policy.this policy
```
